[quote=irocco;61572577][b]Disgust[/b]

The Sealiphate of Irocco, since the collapse of the unjust caliphates, has been a proponent of righteous law and morality; it is the beacon of Islamic Jusprudence in a world which has turned its back on the laws of the Most Merciful and the words of the Most Noble Messenger. It is an insult to this legacy and this way of life that the Democratic Republic of New Westmore would declare us terrorists. Terrorists do not serve the interests of God; to kill innocents would be a violation of the Shari'ah, our morality, our principles. We disagree with the Democratic Republic of New Westmore on many things, secularism, its policy on Mizrahel, its current leadership, but we would never kill the innocent. Nor would we distribute the tools necessary to corrupt the youth of any nation, that being in this instance, opium. 

It is suspected by Amir Al-Mu'mineen that, in fact, the suspects were not Iroccoan, and merely had forged Iroccoan documents to service the export of opium from whatever Cartel influence and products that remain unburned or transformed into legal substances in Maiqahstan. If these are Maiqah, or if they are Iroccoan, it matters not. For they sought to act as corrupters of the world in our name, thus we request that they be extradited to Irocco for punishment under Divine law. As for the investigation, Amir Al-Mu'mineen suggests that his personal bodyguards, the Haras of Irocco, might serve in the search for the third devil, who might likewise proclaim themself a fraudulent slave of God.

As for actions that the Sealiphate will undertake personally, we humbly offer our deepest sympathies for this event orchestrated by these villains. Furthermore, the Sealiphate will initiate a crackdown on all Maiqahistani Mintaqahs to ensure that no more opium and arms will be drawn from that already deeply bloodied stone. May this satisfy the New Westmorian government, we would wish to reenstate our bilateral treaty.

Peace be upon those who follow His guidance,

Chancellor of Foreign Affairs
Imam Khalid 'the Learned' Safvid[/quote]
[b]Response[/b]
[i]We are willing to accept the Iroccoan response as legitimate, and seek to properly resolve this matter. If these people are indeed not terrorists, we would appreciate Iroccoan cooperation in attempts to figure out the true motive behind this attack on our country. In return for cooperation, we will unfreeze our treaty with the Sealiphate.[/i]

[quote=new_westmore;61563251][b]Statement on Dalesburg International Airport Terrorist Attack[/b]
[i]The Democratic Republic of New Westmore has reason to believe that the incident which occurred in Dalesburg International Airport two days ago was a terrorist attack backed by the Sealiphate of Irocco.

Two days ago, an airliner took off from Dalesburg International Airport carrying a large quantity of contraband arms and drugs. This contraband was subsequently dropped over Dalesburg during its flight around the city. The motive as to why remains unclear, but Federal Police investigators have proposed that this was done as a tactic to intimidate or to incite a call to arms against authorities. After the airplane returned to the airport, the occupants on board attempted to escape authorities, and blew up their airplane on the runway as they fled to destroy the evidence. A shootout occurred after, resulting in the deaths of four of our officers and the arrests of two of the men on board. We are still searching for the third occupant of the aircraft. We suspect that the man on the run may have been the pilot in control. We are encouraging anyone with information about this man to come forward as soon as possible - the sooner we get him into custody, the safer our nation will be from this threat of terrorism.

We demand an explanation from the Sealiphate of Irocco. If no explanation is provided, or if our suspicions are vilified, we will push for sanctions and for further action to be taken against them, which may include a total embargo, removal from the Corridor Treaty or condemnation from the ICJ. We will also be completely terminating our bilateral relations with the Sealiphate until further notice - any Westmorians inside Irocco are encouraged to leave before the end of the month.

We strongly condemn any act of terrorism against our nation, and we will not take kindly to foreign actors maliciously interfering with the order of our society. Let it be known that we will not bow to terror regimes that seek to oppress us or disrupt our way of life.[/i]

[b]Short Interview with Premier Vos[/b]

The armored NMF P6 rolled to a stop near the aircraft stairs.
Premier Arlan Vos stepped out before the door had fully opened, with his usual look, of a long unbuttoned coat, and a full black Stresemann below, one hand adjusting the cuff of his sleeve as he walked towards the jet. 
Merely two security guards followed him, uncommon compared to his usual eight-headed squad, ever since the assassination of Premier Onu. It suggested a business flight to a partner state.
A narrow corridor had been left between the barricades and the stairs, just wide enough for him to pass through. Reporters were already leaning forward, with their microphones extended, and questions overlapping before he made a proper step.

[i]Premier Vos, are you heading towards Hyperion to discuss the Corridors future?

Arlan, are you still denying the cruelties your so called anti-terrorism units are putting onto the muslim population?

Sir, can you confirm economic counter measures against the war in the White Strait, targeting our partner Rosenmarkke?

Premier Vos, are you going to further allow Shamatine immigrants to steal Tiraki jobs?

Premier, is it true that Vespurias is funding the killing of thousands of muslims within Tirakan?[/i]

He didnt slow down though. As the security held his path free, he kept walking unbothered.
Yet another voice caught his attention, cutting through the noise.

[i]Mr. Vos, what is Tirakans response to the terror attack on the Dalesburg International airport? New Westmore frames the Sealiphate of Irocco, both Corridor members. Is this the end of the short-whiled organization?[/i]

That made him stop.

He turned toward the line of microphones. As the cameras framed his face, the noise dropped significantly. He didnt step closer, as the path was narrow enough anyway.

[i]The end of the Corridor will come when the world sinks into anarchy and humanity gives up on its values of connectivity and common prosperity. I have to contact President Lundy about the ongoings in New Westmore, before making further decisions. It is not Tirakans cup of tea to meddle in affairs of such uncertainty and emotion. Although I guarantee; the Corridor will investigate the situation and stand up for the responsibility it carries."[/i]

A pause.

[i]We wish the victims and families of the cruel terror attack our sincerest condolences and speedy well-being.[/i]

The loud noise and questions surged again, as he turned and made his final way to the jet.

[i]Does that mean no involvement?

Will the culprit face expulsion from the Corridor?

Is Tirakan mediating the situation?[/i]

But he was already moving up the stairs, into the aircraft. He turned around and waved one time before entering the Falcon 800ZP.
